name: Hotaru
source:
In this love simulation game for gay men, the hero (you) encounters 8 men, meeting up and breaking up with each one as the story unfolds.

[From [url=http://www.rainbow-shoppers.com/en/www/list.cgi?id=G000518100010]Rainbow Shoppers[/url]]
translation:
这是一款面向男同性恋者的恋爱模拟游戏。主人公，也就是你，会遇见八名男性，随着故事展开，与每人相遇又分离。

[摘自[url=http://www.rainbow-shoppers.com/en/www/list.cgi?id=G000518100010]Rainbow Shoppers[/url]]
